mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO t_i18n_release_change (change_id, application_id, release_no, locale_code, key_code, change_type, text, create_time) VALUES
(#{row.changeId}, #{row.applicationId}, #{row.releaseNo}, #{row.localeCode}, #{row.keyCode}, #{row.changeType}, #{row.text}, #{row.createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT locale_code AS localeCode, key_code AS keyCode, text FROM ( SELECT locale_code, key_code, change_type, text, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY locale_code, key_code ORDER BY release_no DESC) AS rn FROM t_i18n_release_change WHERE application_id = #{applicationId} AND release_no <= #{releaseNo} ) latest WHERE rn = 1 AND change_type <> 'REMOVED'
